meta.name: agent-harness
meta.description: Turn any domain folder of skills into a bounded agentic loop: compile a goal into a verifiable task plan, execute tasks with the domain's own tools, verify every task with machine-run checks, retry with caps, escalate to a human when budgets exhaust, and refuse to close until everything is verified or explicitly waived. Use when you want an agent or subagent to pick up a goal and drive it to a verified close across one of this repo's 18 domains ('run this goal through the engineering harness', 'set up an agentic loop for marketing work', 'make the finance domain self-verifying'). NOT for authoring Claude Code Workflow-tool .js scripts (workflow-builder), N-agent tournaments on one task (agenthub), single-file metric optimization (autoresearch-agent), or discovering published loop recipes (loop-library).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意技能文件夹变成可验证的自主执行循环
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让一组技能自动完成目标并逐项验证结果
copy.tagline_en: Turn any skill folder into a verifiable autonomous execution loop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a set of skills to autonomously achieve a goal with step-by-step verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将一个目标拆解为可验证的任务计划，逐个执行任务，自动运行检查验证结果，失败时重试（最多3次），预算耗尽时升级给人类处理，所有任务验证通过或明确豁免后才关闭。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 在某个领域（如工程、营销、财务）内驱动一个目标到可验证的完成时触发，例如“通过工程 harness 运行这个目标”。

say.text: 审计支付服务并设计一个带有错误预算的SLO。
say.note: Claude 会编译目标、生成任务计划并驱动循环。

say.text: 为营销工作设置一个代理循环。
say.note: Claude 会使用营销领域的技能和检查来执行。
Claude 会编译目标并运行验证循环。
